supersedes_within_sepolia.reason: PetitionRegistryV2 superseded by 0x4CaEeAFb…1757 on 2026-05-29T18:33Z after collapsing petitions to support-only (task #38): dropped the BallotMode enum (Signature/YesNo/YesNoAbstain) and the per-vote yes/no/abstain counters + voteByNullifier(uint8) encoding. A petition is now a one-directional support instrument — sign to support, revoke to withdraw; the per-nullifier slot is a plain bool. createPetition/signPetition lost their mode/vote args. EnrollmentRegistry + UltraVerifierV2 reused (the v2 circuit never bound the vote, so no zk/verifier change), so all existing local vaults remain valid against the new petition registry.

PetitionRegistryV2 superseded by 0x3bad7B7d…dbF7 on 2026-05-29T17:55Z after the revoke + voteByNullifier storage refactor (task #35). Old PetitionRegistryV2 carried demo petition #1 + the user's first end-to-end signed signature. EnrollmentRegistry + UltraVerifierV2 reused (no storage change), so all existing local vaults remain valid against the new petition registry.
